guide.title: Medivh's Overview
guide.text:
Medivh is a ranged Support with an exceptional
amount of utility, which makes him one of the most flexible and adaptable
Heroes in the game. His Force of Will possesses
incredible synergy with Tanks and melee Assassins, in particular,
Portal can be used to execute deadly ganks
or tricky escape manoeuvres. One of Medivh's greatest strengths is his ability
to scout the battlefield with his Raven Form. Doing
so gathers valuable information for his team, which allows them to
always be one step ahead of their opponents. With all the utility Medivh
provides, he also requires a lot of game knowledge and experience to
unleash his full potential. However, if played well, Medivh can single-handedly
influence the outcome of a game in his team's favour.

guide.title: Medivh's Synergies and Counters
guide.text:
Medivh synergizes with
Medivh is a very powerful enabler of aggressive hard-engaging Assassins.
Allowing those Heroes to become Invulnerable for 1.5 seconds can help them
go for the big plays and escape dangerous situations.
A very popular combo with Medivh is the Stitches Gorge into Portal or the Ley-line Seal into Diablo Apocalypse
Medivh is countered by
Medivh does not have any natural counters per se, however, he is generally
susceptible to damage over time. Poison damage continues to tick after Force of Will
expires and as such the Ability loses some of its value. Crowd control effects, such as
Malfurion's Entangling Roots
can be placed at the entrance of a Portal, preventing allies or Medivh to move, so when
playing against those Heroes, use Portals with caution.

guide.title: Medivh's Maps
guide.text:

Medivh's weaker maps
Medivh thrives on battlegrounds that allow him to scout the enemy team's rotations.
Consequently, Cursed Hollow or Sky Temple are great choices for him to
be deployed. Make sure to use Portal to allow allied Heroes to surprise
enemies and keep your team informed on their moves. Mercenary and Boss Camps, in particular, are important
to track, as they allow your allies to either contest them or rotate accordingly to take them out swiftly.

guide.title: Medivh's Tips and Tricks
guide.text:
Raven Form is a formidable scouting tool that can allow your team to intercept enemy Heroes.
Portal can be used aggressively to chase down enemy Heroes and initate team fights from an unexpected angle. It can also be used defensively to help allied Heroes escape.
Ley Line Seal can be the ideal foundation for other AoE abilities to follow up on. It can also be used to steal Mercenary or Boss Camps if all enemy Heroes are trapped inside.
Poly Bomb can be a great tool to punish aggressive enemy Assassins, such as Tracer or Genji.
See our Abilities page for further information »

guide.title: Medivh's Role in the Current Meta
guide.text:
Medivh has the rare ability to make allies Invulnerable for a short
period of time using Force of Will. This makes
him an ideal match with aggressive Assassins and Bruisers, such as Illidan,
Tracer, or Sonya.
Raven Form proves to be an incredibly useful
scouting tool, as enemy Heroes cannot attack Medivh while he is in that
form. This allows him to gather intel on enemy movement and rotations,
however, he should not separate himself too far from his teammates, since
the Raven's Movement Speed is slower than that of normal mounts. Furthermore,
Medivh can wreak havoc within the enemy lines due to the exceptional
crowd control effects provided by both of his Heroic Abilities, Poly Bomb
and Ley Line Seal.

abilities.title: Medivh's Tips and Tricks
abilities.text:
Raven Form is a formidable scouting tool that can allow your team to intercept enemy Heroes.
Portal can be used aggressively to chase down enemy Heroes and initate team fights from an unexpected angle. It can also be used defensively to help allied Heroes escape.
Ley Line Seal can be the ideal foundation for other AoE abilities to follow up on. It can also be used to steal Mercenary or Boss Camps if all enemy Heroes are trapped inside.
Poly Bomb can be a great tool to punish aggressive enemy Assassins, such as Tracer or Genji.

abilities.title: Arcane Rift
abilities.text:
Arcane Rift
(Q)
Medivh
Mana: 50
Cooldown: 7 seconds
Launch a rift that deals 170 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in its path. If an enemy Hero is hit, reduce its cooldown by 5 seconds and refund 50 Mana.
Quest: Hit 40 enemy Heroes with Arcane Rift without dying.
Reward: Permanently increase the damage dealt by 75 and cooldown reduction for hitting a Hero by 1 second.
Being Medivh's only damage source, Arcane Rift
becomes a crucial ability to clear Minion waves and to damage enemy Heroes.
Keep in mind that Arcane Rift should usually be aimed in a way that it
hits at least one enemy Hero in order to keep its cooldown as low as possible.
As with other ranged Heroes, we suggest keeping a safe distance to enemy
Tanks and melee Assassins when playing as Medivh, which is why Arcane
Rift should only be cast if it is safe to do so.

abilities.title: Force of Will
abilities.text:
Force of Will
(W)
Medivh
Mana: 60
Cooldown: 9 seconds
Protect an allied Hero from all damage for 1.5 seconds. Upon expiration, Force of Will heals the target for 20% of the damage it absorbed.
Force of Will proves to be an incredibly powerful
single-target protection ability, which gets most value if used on aggressive
(melee) Assassins and Tanks, such as Illidan,
Sonya, or Tracer.
During team fights it should be cast as frequently as possible in order to
keep frontliners and other important target in
good shape.

abilities.title: Portal
abilities.text:
Portal
(E)
Medivh
Cooldown: 16 seconds
Create a set of portals between Medivh and the target location, allowing allies to teleport between both. The portals last 6 seconds.
There is hardly any ability that can be used as flexibly as Portal.
One the one hand, it provides your teammates with a fantastic way to escape
chasing enemies. On the other hand, it can be used to allow your allies
to hunt down retreating enemies more efficiently. If combined with
Medivh's Raven Form, Portal can make for powerful
and surprising combinations. Simply fly close to an enemy target and
immediately follow up by casting Portal towards the direction of your
nearby allies. This causes them to immediately appear next to you and
your chosen enemy target.

abilities.title: Poly Bomb
abilities.text:
In this section we discuss how this Heroic Ability works and give some tips on how to use it.
If you are looking for a detailed explanation on when and why you should pick it,
check out the dedicated section in the Talent Build page.
Poly Bomb
(R)
Medivh
Heroic
Mana: 75
Cooldown: 40 seconds
Polymorph an enemy Hero for 2 seconds, Silencing them and making them unable to attack. On expiration, Poly Bomb spreads to other nearby enemy Heroes.
Poly Bomb truly shines if cast on an enemy
melee Hero that is currently surrounded by other melee Heroes. Furthermore,
keep an eye out for targets that are currently impaired by Movement Speed
slowing effects, Stuns, Roots, and Silences, as they struggle running
away from their teammates in time. This ultimately results in Polybomb spreading
multiple times, which can single-handedly decide the outcome of a team
fight.

abilities.title: Ley Line Seal
abilities.text:
In this section we discuss how this Heroic Ability works and give some tips on how to use it.
If you are looking for a detailed explanation on when and why you should pick it,
check out the dedicated section in the Talent Build page.
Ley Line Seal
(R)
Medivh
Heroic
Mana: 75
Cooldown: 80 seconds
After 0.5 seconds, unleash a wave of energy that places enemy Heroes in Time Stop for 3 seconds.
Ley Line Seal is a high risk high reward
Heroic Ability. It can be used in a variety of ways, however, the most common
goal when casting Ley Line Seal is to trap enemy Heroes for your allies to follow up on.
Sometimes, Ley Line Seal can be used to keep enemy Heroes at bay, allowing allied Heroes
to escape to safety. Since this ability puts targets into Stasis, it is possible to steal Mercenary
or Boss Camps if every enemy Hero on the capture platform is trapped.

abilities.title: Raven Form
abilities.text:
Raven Form
(D)
Medivh
Passive
Instead of mounting, Medivh can transform into a raven, increasing Movement Speed by 20%. While transformed, Medivh can see and fly over all terrain and is immune to all effects.
We recommend using Raven Form as often as possible
to scout important locations, such as Map Objectives or Mercenary Camps.
Vision-obscured terrain (e.g. Bushes, Steam, etc.) that
might serve as an enemy ambush spot should be carefully examined while in
Raven Form to prevent your allies from walking into a trap.

talent_pages.title: Discussion
talent_pages.text:
Raven's Intellect offers much needed Mana and Health Regeneration
to Medivh. However, the only reason to pick this Talent is if you are unable to utilize Portal Mastery
properly.
Portal Mastery is a great Talent, since it allows Medivh
to use Portal without breaking Raven Form, which
allows him to save allies without exposing himself to enemy Heroes.
Winds of Celerity feels underwhelming because Raven Form's
original Movement Speed already feels fast enough.
See our Medivh Portal Mastery Guide for further information »

talent_pages.title: Discussion
talent_pages.text:
Dust of Appearance isn't needed for Medivh
as his Raven Form already provides enough vision to keep up with the enemy team.
Raven Familiar offers enough damage
to make it worth the investment. Furthermore, the Slow is surprisingly strong
when it comes to chasing enemy Heroes down or keeping them at a distance.
Mage Armor is not worth picking up over
the damage boost gained from Raven Familiar

talent_pages.title: Discussion
talent_pages.text:
Arcane Explosion is particularly effective if
the enemy team consists of multiple Melee Assassins
and Tanks who will
take damage at the same time if they stand to close to each other.
Since you will be picking Medivh with a dive composition, you will always want to pick
Arcane Explosion because of the burst synergy it offers.
Force of Magic is a lackluster Talent compared to Arcane Explosion.
35% Spell Power won't out damage the burst gained from Arcane Explosion.
Mystic Assault's reward is not good enough to justify the
condition of landing Arcane Rift on an enemy Hero.

talent_pages.title: Discussion
talent_pages.text:
In this section we discuss when and why to pick a given Heroic Ability.
If you want to read how they work in detail and/or you are looking for some tips on how to use them,
check them out on the Abilities and Strategy page.
Poly Bomb is an incredibly useful Heroic Ability
against melee Heroes in particular who usually clump up while focusing
on an enemy target. Heroes who get value by playing aggressively, such as
Sonya and Illidan,
suffer greatly from being crowd controlled while engaging on their target.
It is quite important to keenly observe the course of battle before
casting Poly Bomb. Make sure to use it when the
enemy team groups up and/or is impaired by Slow and Stuns,
which will make it much harder for them to spread out.
Ley Line Seal has the potential of single-handedly
winning or losing a team fight. If it successfully hits multiple enemy
Heroes, your team can set up a strong follow-up combination. However,
if it misses, it has literally zero value and you will have wasted a
relatively long cooldown in vain. Furthermore, Ley Line Seal's travel
animation is very slow, which usually allows enemies to dodge it.

talent_pages.title: Discussion
talent_pages.text:
Circle of Protection is an amazing Talent if
your team consists of multiple Melee Assassins
and Tanks who generally
tend to group up when focusing the same target. This Talent should only be
picked if the enemy team has something like Azmodan who will always try to
cast his globe on your team.
Reabsorption's extra healing on just one allied target
feels underwhelming
when Circle of Protection has the ability to
completely protect several allies at the same time.
Enduring Will is your go-to Talent in most games.
The reduced cooldown is huge and can allow you to protect an ally from
tons of damage in teamfights.

talent_pages.title: Discussion
talent_pages.text:
Stable Portal is a very versatile Talent that offers plenty of
benefits. Lowering the cooldown and extending the duration of Portal
allows Medivh's team to cover larger distances more frequently and reliably. As a result,
it also provides strong synergy with Raven Familiar at Level 4.
Arcane Charge is a good Talent if
you are an experienced Medivh player and have the timing and accuracy to consistently
land multiple Arcane Rifts.
Temporal Flux can be useful when paired with
Ley Line Seal whose cooldown is significantly higher than
Poly Bomb. This Talent can allow Medivh to dish out more
Heroic Abilities during a teamfight.

talent_pages.title: Discussion
talent_pages.text:
Glyph Of Poly Bomb now lets you target an area and the
polymorph is instant, allowing for a quick CC so your team can follow-up. The radius increase
makes it easier to spread the polymorph aswell! There can be some value in saving
Polymorph and rather use it as a follow-up CC as the bomb now hits twice.
Medivh Cheats! tackles one of Ley Line Seal's
main issues, which is the slow projectile speed. The ability to manually redirect
the course of Ley Line Seal once allows Medivh
to catch enemies that he would have missed otherwise.
Guardian of Tirisfal offers potentially decent
waveclear, which unfortunately comes too late
in the game to be relevant in most games.
Dust of Disappearance's very low cooldown make it a tempting
Talent at first glance. However, the Talent remains unimpactful
in most situations, especially during team fights.
Arcane Brilliance only makes sense if your team
features Heroes like Kael'thas
or Li-Ming who are quite Mana hungry
and actually benefit from increased Spell Damage.
